{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness subagent delegation enhancement","id":"gh:1333698785","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-subagent-tools","slug":"lynx-gt/dsh-subagent-tools","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","subagent"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness subagent delegation enhancement"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-subagent-tools"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Enhanced subagent delegation tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh):
**per-call model / provider / persona"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" / toolFilter overrides**, **`@preset:` persona references**, and
**`provider/model` composite model"},{"id":"p3s3","text":" ids** — shipped as a standard **bundle** that patches **no official
package file**."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"| English | 中文 |"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What it adds"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The stock `subagent` / `subagent_fork` tools only accept `description`, `prompt`, and `run_in_backgr"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ound`.
This plugin replaces them with the same surface plus per-call overrides:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Parameter | Effect |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| `model` | Override the child's LLM model for this call. Accepts a bare id (`k3`) or a composite (`"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"kimi-code/k3`) that also switches the provider. |
| `provider` | Override the delegation provider fo"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"r this call (`spawn` / `fork` / ...). |
| `persona` | Override the child's persona for this call — r"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"aw text, or `@preset:<id>` to load a saved agent preset's persona (by display name or directory id)."},{"id":"p8s5","text":" |
| `toolFilter` | Override the child's tool allow/deny filter for this call. |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"All overrides default to the instance configuration, so a bare install behaves exactly like the stoc"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"rides default to the instance configuration, so a bare install behaves exactly like the stock tools."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Restart `dsh --profile web`."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### Web sessions: also run the preset adapter (important)"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"In the **web** profile, agent tools are provided by the mounted agent **preset**
(the default `stand"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ard` preset composes `subagent` / `subagent_fork` pointing at
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent`), **n"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ot** by the host plane. A bundle patch that
disables the stock rows and inserts its own is invisible"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" to Web sessions — the
stock tools keep loading and this package's per-call overrides never appear
("},{"id":"p14s5","text":"headless works without this step)."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Run the preset adapter to make Web sessions use this package:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"It copies the `standard` preset into `$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/standard-plus`,
rewrites its `tool-su"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"bagent` / `tool-subagent-fork` rows to point at this
package, and switches the default preset. Then "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"**restart `dsh web` and start a
NEW session** (presets are read at session creation and cannot be sw"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"itched in a
live session). To revert: pick `standard` again in the UI (General > Agent
preset) and d"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"elete the `standard-plus` directory."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"> `headless` and other non-web profiles do not need this step."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Telling the model which presets exist (`presetHints`)"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The `persona` parameter accepts `@preset:<id>` references, but the tool schema
does not list which p"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"resets exist on your deployment. Set `presetHints` on the
tool rows (see `cordis.patch.yml`) to surf"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"ace them in the schema — the model
then sees "Available presets on this deployment: @preset:翻译员, ..."},{"id":"p20s4","text":"" and can
pick one itself. Omit the key to stay generic (presets differ per machine)."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Compatibility"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Declares `peerDependencies` on the public dsh packages (`^0.1.0-rc.6`). If your dsh version moves ou"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"t of
the compatible range, pnpm reports a peer conflict and the plugin refuses to load — bump this p"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"ackage
instead of running on a silently broken API."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Verified"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Tested against a stock dsh `0.1.0-rc.6` install (no local patches) on Windows via
headless and web p"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"gainst a stock dsh `0.1.0-rc.6` install (no local patches) on Windows via
headless and web profiles:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- per-call `model="kimi-code/k3"` composite routing ✅
- per-call `provider="fork"` and raw-text `per"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"sona` ✅
- `@preset:` by display name (`@preset:审校员`) and directory id (`@preset:translation-reviewer"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"`) ✅
- `presetHints` schema injection ✅
- Web profile: the preset adapter (`install-preset.ps1`) mak"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"es Web sessions use
this bundle's tools (verified with the 5 presets above in a live web session)"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Example"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Design"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- **A bundle, not a patched install.** This package is a standard dsh **bundle**
(`dsh.bundle` manif"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"est + `cordis.patch.yml`): it disables the shipped
`tool-subagent` / `tool-subagent-fork` rows and i"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"nserts its own. **No official
package file is patched** — nothing in the dsh installation is modifie"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"d.
- **Independent implementation.** The tool is written against the public dsh API
(`defineTool`, `"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"ctx.subagents.start` / `startContinuable`, `settleRun`), not a fork of the official source.
- **Upgr"},{"id":"p29s6","text":"ades.** The bundle lives in the profile's own `node_modules` (pnpm
symlink), so a dsh upgrade does n"},{"id":"p29s7","text":"ot remove it. But dsh is in developer preview
(rc.6): if an upgrade changes the public API, `peerDep"},{"id":"p29s8","text":"endencies` makes the
plugin refuse to load instead of failing silently — bump this package then.
- *"},{"id":"p29s9","text":"*No `cwd` parameter here.** Per-call working-directory control needs two
small patches in the dsh in"},{"id":"p29s10","text":"stallation's in-process subagent providers
(foreground + continuable child creation). That lives in "},{"id":"p29s11","text":"the companion
package **`dsh-subagent-tools-cwd`**, which bundles this plugin's
functionality **plus"},{"id":"p29s12","text":"** the `cwd` parameter **plus** the required patches.
Install one or the other — not both."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- **`@preset:` depends on the local preset layout.** `$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets`
is where dsh stores "},{"id":"p31s2","text":"user-authored presets; the path is not a hard public
contract, so a future dsh release could change "},{"id":"p31s3","text":"discovery. Presets also differ
per machine — an `@preset:翻译员` reference only works where that preset"},{"id":"p31s4","text":" exists.
- **Web sessions need the preset adapter.** The `standard` preset that ships
with dsh still"},{"id":"p31s5","text":" points its delegation rows at the official package; until you
run `install-preset.ps1` / `install-p"},{"id":"p31s6","text":"reset.sh`, Web sessions keep the stock
tools (headless and other non-web profiles use this bundle di"},{"id":"p31s7","text":"rectly).
- **`provider` means the subagent backend**, not an LLM provider. To route a
child to a dif"},{"id":"p31s8","text":"ferent LLM provider use the composite `model` id
(`kimi-code/k3`) or the instance `agentOptions`."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
